summary: C28 adds a versioned 5-sensor target workload (30 s at 8 events/s plus a 500-event batched backlog) and over-limit probes over the real C05/C11/C16 ingest and C17/C18 segment projection paths. Under an enforced 2 vCPU / 2048 MiB systemd user scope the engine sustained 8.01 events/s (240/240), ingested 740 events with 740 durable acknowledgements, used 37.5 s CPU over 76.0 s wall, 21.13 MiB ingest / 96.02 MiB peak process RSS and 998590 bytes of state, and projected 740 records into 2 segments with the C05 manifest unchanged. Restart preserved counts, revision and manifest bytes, and the second projection appended nothing. Single-event p99 was 86.8 ms; HTTP p99 at concurrency 128 was 43.5 ms with zero errors. The 20 events/s planning target completed only 171/200 events in 10 s, so published capacity and the product/ops documents now report the measured 8 events/s. Typed over-limit batch, storage-quota and cancellation results passed, together with 38 measured assertions, 195 engine anchors, 88 Node tests and 6 Python tests.
hosted_actions_note: Not run for this source. No push or publication occurred; remote workflow status is unverified.
scope_limits: Local Linux single-operator profile only; the 2 vCPU/2048 MiB enforcement is a user-scope cgroup on the measured host, not a capacity guarantee for other hardware.
The measured workload is a 30-second window plus a bounded backlog, not a multi-day retention, sustained saturation or unbounded-volume claim.
The 20 events/s probe demonstrated saturation at about 17 events/s; it is not a measured maximum throughput.
No browser rendering, hosted Actions, deployment, release, C30 clean-host workflow or C40 artifact claim.
The benchmark used repository-authored synthetic fixtures and an ephemeral in-memory signing key.

The measurement ran before the commit existed; the source identity covers the implementation commit b0d9165 ignoring docs/evidence/, and the later bookkeeping commit changes the current identity only.

local_environment.notes: The machine's go env sets GOSUMDB=off, so engine-spawning Node tests require the documented GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.2 environment. The C28 failing repro is retained in docs/evidence/C28/npm-check-missing-env.log; the same suite passes with the documented environment.
